review_method: Read-only PPTX text/structure inventory and visual inspection of candidate embedded images; no source files changed; no new simulator or hardware run

collections.label: Third folder, USB project presentations at folder root
collections.excluded_subdirectory: Linear_driver: separate later linear-driver research and third-party literature; contents not used in this TX modeling guide

ownership_basis: Author confirmed on 2026-10-07 their direct TX modeling/verification responsibility for the additional materials, including XMODEL integration and serializer verification. Whole analog TX and joint silicon measurements remain distinguished.
scope_notes: Each deck is a development snapshot; filename dates and shared template creation timestamps are not used to prove event chronology.
18-combination test plan is distinct from retained calculations and six specific 8-bit examples.
Full logical roundtrip observes lower 11 bits of six error values and retains clock-edge glitches; no full-width equivalence proof claimed.
Scrambler on/off routing evidence does not establish eye, jitter or BER improvement; the 241210 model/SPICE discrepancy is explicitly described.
250619 MSB/LSB comparison uses idealized power labeling, not final power-integrity validation.
Model-paper 40 Gb/s/lane and fabricated-TX 32 Gb/s are separate results; no new speed metric inferred from draft presimulation sweeps.
Original decks, HDL/IP, standard excerpts, copied third-party paper figures and private PDK/server paths are not published.
Joint electrical architecture explains the user's logical-model connection; whole analog circuitry is not attributed to one designer.

Preset-0/preset-7 eyes are from an idealized XMODEL development model at 25.6 GBaud, VDD 1 V, 5 mA tail-current setting, channel-loss plot 9.89 dB at 12.8 GHz; their vertical axes differ. No maximum-speed or final-chip result inferred.
